Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2000
CENTRAL EXCISES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2000
An Ordinance further to amend the Central Excises Act, 1944
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part I, 9th August, 2000]
No. F. 2(1)/2000‑Pub.,
dated .9‑8‑2000.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This
‑Ordinance may be called the Central Excises (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the 1st day of July,
2000.

Amendment of section 3, Act I of 1944

ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2000
CENTRAL EXCISES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2000
An Ordinance further to amend the Central Excises Act, 1944
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part I, 9th August, 2000]
No. F. 2(1)/2000‑Pub.,
dated .9‑8‑2000.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 3, Act
I of 1944.‑‑In the Central Excises Act, 1944 (I of 1944), in
section 3, in subsection (1), in the second proviso, for the full‑stop at
the end, a colon shall be substituted and after the proviso, amended as
aforesaid, the following new proviso shall be added, namely:‑‑
"Provided
further that notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, in respect of
excisable services which the Federal Government may, by notification in the
official Gazette, specify, the duty shall be levied and collected as if it were
a tax payable under section 3 of the Sales Tax Act, 1990, and all the
provisions of that Act and the rules, notifications, orders and instructions
made or issued thereunder shall, as far as may be and with necessary
modifications, apply."
